subject: Observability add-ons: SKU clarity, commit incentives, and implementation questions

Subject: Observability add-ons — pricing and commit path

Hi Jordan / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the advanced dashboards and trace views look promising. Procurement here at Nimbus has a few follow-ups before we can take this to our finance committee:

- Can you share a clear SKU / invoice example that breaks out retention (30/90/365), tracing ingestion, and advanced dashboard seats?
- Do you offer a blended rate for committed spend vs pay-as-you-go for add-ons, or are they always metered?
- Any standard discount tiers for an annual commit (we're evaluating a 12-month purchasing window)?

We have an internal SOW draft to share once we align on pricing. Can you also send any sample SOW language for retention SLAs?

Appreciate a short reply with the options — we need ballpark numbers to prepare our forecast.

Best,

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pricing and commit path

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Long-form answers below and I attached a concise pricing PDF for your finance team (nimbus-observability-pricing-v1.pdf). TL;DR: we support both slab (bundled) and metered models for add-ons and can offer a meaningful commit discount for a 12-month purchase.

1) SKU / invoice examples
- Retention: three standard SKUs we publish — Retain-30, Retain-90, Retain-365. Invoice line shows: SKU, unit (GB-month), unit price, quantity. Example line: Retain-90 | 1,200 GB-month | $0.012/GB-month | $14,400/mo.
- Tracing ingestion: Traces-Ing (monthly ingested spans), billed per million spans; tiered unit price as volume grows.
- Advanced Dashboards: seat-based license + overage for dashboards beyond included seats.

2) Metered vs Bundled
- Metered: pay as you go (no commit) with published unit prices.
- Bundled (slab): commit to a monthly spend for a SKU mix; we apply a lower effective unit price and include pooling across projects.

3) Commit discounts & incentives
- Standard: 10% off add-on unit prices for a 12-month pre-paid commit at $100k ARR equivalent to add-ons.
- Concession (we can offer to Nimbus for this deal): 18–22% off depending on total platform+addon commitment and a short pilot (see below).

4) SLO / SLA language
- Retention durability and restore windows are in our SOW templates; restoration SLA for archived traces is 24–72 hours depending on retention class.

Pilot suggestion: 3-month pilot with a $20k credit for trace ingestion to validate storage and dashboard performance. If you convert to a 12-month commit, we apply an additional 10% rebate off the first 6 months.

Next steps: if you can share target volumes (approx GB/month for logs/retention, monthly spans) we will produce a model and a redlineable SOW.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Marta — quick color from Ben: based on similar customer patterns in healthcare we recommend the following framing to your finance team:

- Present a hybrid proposal: Retain-90 slab for core services to cover predictable retention needs + metered traces for bursty workloads. This tends to hit the right cost/latency balance.
- For advanced dashboards, include 10 seats in the first year as part of the commit to avoid friction during onboarding.
- We can include a 3-month rollback clause if you materially underuse the committed volumes (<60% usage in the first quarter).

Jordan and I can put together a 2-slide summary you can share with your CFO.

Ben

Marta / Procurement — attaching the firm appendix (20260820-nimbus-pricing.xlsx) and a brief summary below. We reviewed this with Legal and Solutions; highlights: 

- Discount matrix (add-on unit prices): $100k+ commit -> 12% off; $250k+ commit -> 18% off; $500k+ commit -> 22% off. These thresholds are on combined platform + add-on ARR.
- Pilot credit: $20k credit applies to add-ons (trace ingestion & retention) only; if you execute a 12-month commit within 60 days of pilot completion we will credit $10k back to your first invoice as a conversion rebate.
- Dashboard seats: first 10 seats included free for 90 days on conversion to a 12-month commit.
- SOW / SLA: restore SLA for Retain-90 set to 36 hours in the appendix; SOC 2 attestation will be provided via the enterprise onboarding portal (link in the spreadsheet).

Next steps: 1) Tell us target commit band so we can prepare a commercial order form. 2) Legal to review your SOW redlines; we will return a marked SOW by Aug 24.

If that works, Ben and I will set a 30-minute call next week to walk the finance team through the invoice examples.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
